ambiguities_or_notes: The Markdown's opening header is structurally awkward (‘<ins>14 июня</ins>. Я. П.’ followed by a closing bracket). Official volume 46 prints the complete editorial header ‘[14 июня. Я. П.]’; English therefore represents it as ‘[14 June. Y. P.]’ without changing the Russian source.
развить из самого себя хорошее is rendered ‘develop the good out of himself,’ preserving Tolstoy's concrete formulation rather than abstracting it to self-improvement.
дух взял бы верх над материей remains ‘spirit would gain the upper hand over matter.’
во всеобщем is elliptic after всеобщего развития; English uses ‘in the universal whole’ without supplying a more specific philosophical system.
